note: Louisiana's child protection hotline explicitly covers abuse and neglect inside licensed residential and treatment facilities, not only in family homes, so it is the right call for something that happened in a program. Its counseling board, by contrast, will not accept an anonymous complaint at all unless the documents you send with it plainly show a breach of law on their own.

channels.name: Louisiana Licensed Professional Counselors Board of Examiners
channels.what_it_can_do: Receives complaints against licensed professional counselors, provisional licensed professional counselors, and licensed and provisional marriage and family therapists, and disciplines their licences through its Disciplinary Committee.
channels.who_to_report: An LPC, PLPC, LMFT or PLMFT in Louisiana.
channels.how: Use the Board's online complaint form. Include your contact details.
channels.note: Anonymous complaints are not accepted unless the documentation you provide clearly shows a violation of law by itself. The administrator first checks whether the person is within the Board's jurisdiction at all.

channels.name: Louisiana State Board of Examiners of Psychologists
channels.what_it_can_do: Licenses and disciplines psychologists in Louisiana, and exists in statute to protect the public from unauthorised, unqualified and improper practice of psychology.
channels.who_to_report: A licensed psychologist in Louisiana, or somebody practising psychology without authorisation.
channels.how: Submit a complaint through the Board's portal.

channels.name: Louisiana Child Protection Hotline
channels.what_it_can_do: The statutory report line, run by the Department of Children and Family Services, which is mandated to receive and investigate reports of child abuse and neglect - including abuse or neglect occurring in licensed DCFS or Department of Health residential and treatment facilities.
channels.who_to_report: A child at a Louisiana program, including abuse, neglect, sexual abuse and juvenile sex trafficking.
channels.how: Call. It is open every hour of every day of the year, and all calls are confidential.
channels.phone_note: 855-4LA-KIDS. 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.

channels.name: Disability Rights Louisiana
channels.what_it_can_do: Louisiana's Protection and Advocacy agency, with federal authority to investigate abuse and neglect of people with disabilities in facilities, a right of access to them, and free legal advocacy.
channels.who_to_report: A Louisiana program where the young person has a disability or a mental health diagnosis.

channels.name: Louisiana DCFS Licensing Section (Residential Care)
channels.what_it_can_do: Licenses child residential facilities and child placing agencies in Louisiana and enforces the Child Care Facilities and Child Placing Agencies Licensing Act. It has revoked licences and sought injunctions against unlicensed providers.
channels.who_to_report: A child residential facility. Louisiana defines a complaint broadly: any allegation that someone is breaching the standards, or acting or failing to act in a way that harms the health, safety, rights or welfare of a child living there.
channels.how: Contact the Licensing Section. It aims to inspect every residential licensing complaint within 30 days.
channels.phone_note: Licensing staff, 8:00am to 4:30pm weekdays except legal holidays.
channels.note: Louisiana publishes a list of every currently licensed facility, so it is worth checking whether a program holds a licence at all.
